{{Vanilla|Brewing Stand}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''Chemistry Stand''' is the [[Matcha Flavoured]] name for the {{MCW|Brewing Stand|brewing stand}}. [[Brewing]] is effectively removed from the pack, so the Chemistry Stand serves mainly as the job site block of the [[Chemist]] (the pack's cleric) and as decoration.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The vanilla recipe, which needs a blaze rod, is replaced with one that uses an iron ingot and a [[copper ingot]] over three cobblestone, blackstone or cobbled deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/chemistry_stand.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Job site ===
The Chemistry Stand is the job site block of the [[Chemist]], who sells [[Splash Potion|splash potions]].

=== Brewing ===
{{Main|Brewing}}
The Chemistry Stand opens the vanilla brewing interface, titled "Chemistry Stand", but it cannot be fueled: the pack empties the <code>#minecraft:brewing_fuel</code> item tag, which normally holds blaze powder ([[Raw Estus]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/brewing_fuel.json}}</ref>
